required_concepts: A rectangle can have unequal adjacent sides
A rhombus requires all four sides to be equal
A kite does not have two pairs of opposite parallel sides
optional_concepts: Kites and parallelograms are different in their side relationships
acceptable_paraphrases: A rectangle can be longer than a rhombus
Sides of a rectangle need not be equal
A square is a special type of rectangle but not all rectangles are squares
A rectangle with unequal adjacent sides does not have all sides equal
critical_errors: Stating or implying that a rectangle always has four equal sides
Incorrectly stating that opposite sides of a rectangle are parallel (unless contextually correct)
misconceptions: Confusing a rectangle with a square or rhombus
Thinking that all sides of a rectangle must be equal
Believing that a kite has two pairs of parallel sides
Incorrectly stating that rectangles always have the same height
Misunderstanding the properties of parallelograms and their differences from kites
grading_notes: Look for clear, specific references to the concepts. Acceptable paraphrases should be recognized as correct if they convey the necessary information. Penalize for mixing up properties or assuming conditions not stated in the question.
